# Physical robots.txt, added 2026-07-25.
#
# This replaces the WordPress/Yoast virtual robots.txt, which emitted two
# conflicting "User-agent: *" groups -- the second (the Yoast block) carrying an
# empty "Disallow:", i.e. allow-all. Crawlers that honour only the last matching
# group therefore ignored the add-to-cart rules above it. All previous
# directives are preserved below, in a single group.
#
# NOTE: WordPress only generates its virtual robots.txt when no physical file
# exists. Deleting this file restores the old behaviour; any robots change made
# in the Yoast UI while it exists will NOT take effect.

User-agent: *
Disallow: /wp-admin/
Allow: /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php
Disallow: /wp-content/uploads/wc-logs/
Disallow: /wp-content/uploads/woocommerce_transient_files/
Disallow: /wp-content/uploads/woocommerce_uploads/
Disallow: /wp-content/uploads/*b2bking-

# Faceted-search crawl space. Every combination of these parameters is a unique
# URL backed by a full, uncached product query, and add-to-cart writes a
# cart/session row on every hit. Left open, it is an unbounded crawl trap.
Disallow: /*?add-to-cart=
Disallow: /*&add-to-cart=
Disallow: /*?s=
Disallow: /*&s=
Disallow: /*?post_type=product
Disallow: /*&post_type=product
Disallow: /*?min_price=
Disallow: /*&min_price=
Disallow: /*?max_price=
Disallow: /*&max_price=
Disallow: /*?per_page=
Disallow: /*&per_page=
Disallow: /*?per_row=
Disallow: /*&per_row=
Disallow: /*?shop_view=
Disallow: /*&shop_view=
Disallow: /*?orderby=
Disallow: /*&orderby=

# Meta's crawler. A crawler obeys ONLY its most specific matching group and
# ignores "User-agent: *" entirely, so every rule above is repeated here --
# omitting them would hand meta-externalagent a blanket allow, which is the
# exact bug this file was written to fix.
User-agent: meta-externalagent
Crawl-delay: 30
Disallow: /wp-admin/
Allow: /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php
Disallow: /wp-content/uploads/wc-logs/
Disallow: /wp-content/uploads/woocommerce_transient_files/
Disallow: /wp-content/uploads/woocommerce_uploads/
Disallow: /wp-content/uploads/*b2bking-
Disallow: /*?add-to-cart=
Disallow: /*&add-to-cart=
Disallow: /*?s=
Disallow: /*&s=
Disallow: /*?post_type=product
Disallow: /*&post_type=product
Disallow: /*?min_price=
Disallow: /*&min_price=
Disallow: /*?max_price=
Disallow: /*&max_price=
Disallow: /*?per_page=
Disallow: /*&per_page=
Disallow: /*?per_row=
Disallow: /*&per_row=
Disallow: /*?shop_view=
Disallow: /*&shop_view=
Disallow: /*?orderby=
Disallow: /*&orderby=
Disallow: /cart/
Disallow: /checkout/
Disallow: /my-account/
